about_the_game:
A gigantic "Thank You" to all you amazing farmers!

If you're having a blast on Your Big, Cute Monster Farm and feel like giving KaiPlay Studio a little extra boost to help us keep making cool games, this Supporter Pack is the perfect way to show your love!

As our special thanks, this pack is filled with awesome cosmetic goodies to make your farm even cuter:

  • Dynamic Decoration-Goddess Statue

  • Storehouse-"Skygarden" Skin

  • Monster Hatch Center-"Skygarden" Skin

  • Monster Trade Center-"Skygarden" Skin

  • Monster Fusion Center-"Skygarden" Skin

How to change skins: After purchasing the DLC, simply click on an eligible building, tap the "Skin" icon in the top-right corner, and select your new look!

Just a friendly heads-up: This pack is 100% cosmetic! It's all about style and does not provide any in-game buffs or advantages. Just pure, unadulterated cuteness!
